sources.title: [26.8] Challenger Rakan Guide 🪶 How to Win Consistently
[26.17] War is in the dance! - A comprehensive Rakan guide.

spells.name: Gleaming Quill
spells.text: Flings a magical feather that deals magic damage. Striking a champion or epic monster enables Rakan to heal his allies.

spells.name: Grand Entrance
spells.text: Dashes to a location, knocking up nearby enemies on arrival.

spells.name: Battle Dance
spells.text: Flies to an allied champion granting them a shield. Can be re-cast for free for a short duration.

spells.name: The Quickness
spells.text: Gains Move Speed, charming and dealing magic damage to enemies touched.

damage.value: Rakan deals burst magic damage with Gleaming Quill and The Quickness.

archetype.value: Rakan is a mobile support with a versatile playstyle and strong teamfighting and roaming potential.

winCondition.value: Rakan wins by reading situations, identifying what his team needs, and acting at the right moment.

spikes.at: Grand Entrance cooldown falls from 14 to 10 seconds
spikes.why: Rakan can attempt its knockup more often as the cooldown decreases.

bait.why: After Rakan uses Grand Entrance, its cooldown leaves Rakan unable to use that knockup again.

mistakes.value: Rakan players can enter fights before a key crowd-control threat is spent, losing their chance to contribute.
Rakan players can mistake a messy-looking fight for a bad one even when they fulfilled their role.
Rakan cannot enable Gleaming Quill’s heal unless the feather strikes a champion or epic monster.
